property_summary: After an attacker with a recorded balance withdraws while re-entering, C pays out the recorded balance exactly once (the lock makes the re-entrant call revert and the outer withdrawal completes atomically), so C's ether balance is unchanged beyond that single payout; the mutant's missing lock lets the re-entrant call pay again, draining extra ether from the contract.
change_summary: Delete the statement setting __lock_modifier0_lock to true, effectively removing the reentrancy guard.
